items.text: A video shows a long line of vehicles waiting to receive diesel fuel at the Qazalhesar fuel station in Karaj. The video was released by Iran International. It highlights the demand situation for fuel in this area.

Bourgan Nezami, an economist, stated that the 18% increase in the exchange rate over the past three months and a 3% rise in the last week indicate ongoing pressure on Iran's foreign exchange resources. He identified the restriction of currency supply channels as a cause for Iran's economy entering a period of economic decline. He also warned that further pressures could worsen the situation.

Hossein Aghaei from Iran International said the Islamic Republic faces a survival equation amid economic pressure, naval blockade, and military pressure. Tehran is seeking to buy time through diplomatic activities in New York. It also threatens to make oil export routes unsafe to increase the costs of pressure against itself.

Financial Times reported that cooperation between Yemen's Houthis and the Somali militant group al-Shabaab has increased, and US officials have warned about its consequences for regional stability and shipping in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. According to the report, the Houthis have sold weapons to al-Shabaab and trained hundreds of its fighters to use drones and explosives. Matt Bryden, former head of the UN panel of experts on Somalia, said around 1,500 Somali fighters, including al-Shabaab members, have likely been trained alongside the Houthis in Yemen.

Morteza Kazemian described Qalibaf's threat to block oil exports from regional countries as a continuation of the Islamic Republic's approach. He characterized this stance as a move towards maximum confrontation. Kazemian expressed concern about the consequences of this approach for the country's future.

Hadi Eidipour, head of Shiraz Fire Department, announced that 20 unsafe schools have been identified in the city. Among them, six schools are high-risk and require urgent attention from the education department. Additionally, 203 high-risk and unsafe buildings have been identified in Shiraz.

The aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt has departed from San Diego base to the US Central Command operational area in the Middle East. This carrier will replace the USS George Washington. The simultaneous presence of two US carrier strike groups in the region will continue.

Fatemeh Mohajerani, the government spokesperson, confirmed the increase in economic pressure and inflation on households. She stated that the ration card is to help people's livelihoods and promised to increase its amount. War conditions and the costs of repairing damaged infrastructure have caused changes in government expenses.

Abbas Araghchi stated that a Qatari intermediary met with the Iranian side to discuss ways to fulfill the Islamic Republic's conditions. Iran's seven-point plan has been conveyed to the Americans. The Islamic Republic is awaiting an official response from the US through intermediaries.

The mother of Mohammadreza Ahangar baked a cake in memory of her son and blew out the candle saying "hoping for the freedom of the homeland." Mohammadreza Ahangar, 20 years old, was killed on January 8, 2026, in Tehran. This video has been recently released.

Despite the Ministry of Energy's announcement about the end of power outages, reports indicate that electricity cuts continue in the provinces of Isfahan, Markazi, and Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari. This issue has been reported by Iran International. More details were provided by Leila Saadati.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf responded to Trump in a parliamentary speech saying, "Turn so we can turn." Trump had previously stated that the US would win against the Islamic Republic through economic pressure and military action. The Wall Street Journal reported that Trump expects bombing of the Islamic Republic to resume after the US midterm elections.
A video shows military equipment and armed forces present in a school in eastern Tehran. The video was received by Iran International. No further details have been provided.

Three Bahá'í citizens named Hengameh Sharifinia, Foad Abdolghafari, and Fahim Agahi were sentenced by Branch 15 of Tehran Revolutionary Court to a total of 35 years in prison and additional penalties. These penalties include travel bans, prohibition from group activities, and confiscation of property. The verdict was issued in late September by Judge Salavati.

Majid Vahid Berimanlou won the gold medal in the 66 kg Kurash category at the Nagoya Asian Games. He dedicated the medal to the nomads and the people of his country. Berimanlou defeated Yasin Bobakalonov from Tajikistan in the final.

The IRGC in a letter to the American people declared the Islamic Republic victorious in the war with the US. The letter attributed this victory mainly to Mojtaba Khamenei's leadership. The IRGC also described the US as lacking similar leadership.
Public sector workers in France are striking in protest against government wage policies. The basis for salary calculation will remain unchanged next year. This news was reported by Sajedeh Sharifi.

Hamid Mahdavi's sister released a video on Firefighter Day. Hamid Mahdavi, a 38-year-old firefighter, was killed on January 8, 2026, in Mashhad. He was shot directly by officers while helping the injured.

Ghazal Marzban, a Christian convert imprisoned in Evin, has gone on a hunger strike due to being denied access to religious books. She is also deprived of family visits. She faces an open apostasy case and another case related to the protests of December 2025.

A citizen protested the severe increase in drug prices in a video to Iran International. He said people's income does not cover the cost of medicine. This person holds the Islamic Republic responsible for this situation.

The price of the dollar in Tehran's free market has surpassed 250,000 tomans for the first time. The US Treasury Secretary mentioned the possibility of the dollar reaching 300,000 tomans. The economic secretary of Iran International also confirmed this possibility if current conditions continue.

Iran International's truth discovery campaign reports organized torture, deprivation of medicine and food, and unhygienic conditions in the Dastgerd and Dowlatabad prisons in Isfahan. One account reveals new details about the arrest and torture of Alireza Sepahi, sentenced to death in the Ali Khani Square case. The report is provided by Farnoush Faraji.

The Cultural Commission of the Parliament warned about cultural infiltration in a meeting with Ministry of Intelligence officials. It was emphasized that a complex plan to promote nudity, desensitization, and family disintegration has begun. Efforts to change beliefs and lifestyle towards a Western way of life were also highlighted.

Mojtaba Khamenei made statements about the Islamic Republic of Iran being a superpower. Users on social media have reacted differently to these remarks. Most reactions have criticized and mocked these claims.

Masoud Babapour stated at the 'Iran Prosperity Project' meeting that opponents of the Islamic Republic are shifting from solely opposing the regime to presenting plans for the post-regime period. He noted European politicians' concerns about Iran's future and emphasized the need for a plan to ensure stability after the Islamic Republic. Babapour mentioned the consolidation of Prince Reza Pahlavi's leadership as part of this plan.

Caspian Airlines announced that the plane seized in Turkey will return to Iran on Tuesday. The plane was seized due to a 3 million euro debt and a court order. Legal and administrative follow-ups have been made to lift the seizure.

Negin Hamedi, the international relations officer of the Janis network, said the network aims to organize Iranian students abroad and create more space for views opposing the Islamic Republic. Janis operates in several European countries and aims to connect the academic world to the political world at the European Parliament. The network seeks to attract European politicians' attention to proposed plans for Iran's future after the Islamic Republic.

On the evening of Tuesday, October 6, a missile was launched in the city of Mashhad among government supporters. This video was released by Iran International. No further details about the incident have been reported.

The Israeli Prime Minister warned that enemies might attack Israel as elections approach. He mentioned recent military operations in Gaza and Lebanon and emphasized that Israel will not allow retreat from its military achievements. The parliamentary elections are scheduled for October 27.

Alireza Fazeli, a political prisoner, was released from Evin Prison on Tuesday, 7 Mehr. The early release followed the issuance of a pardon directive. After release, he will be subject to restrictions on residence and travel in Tehran and neighboring provinces.

Donald Trump confirmed that US officials have held talks with mediators seeking to end the war with the Islamic Republic, but did not provide further details. He also said the US will win the war 'in any form' and that this will happen 'very quickly'.

Reports indicate water and electricity outages in various regions of Iran, including Siyah Kuh village in Gilan. Prices of essential goods and medical services have risen sharply. Farmers complain about delayed payments for their products.

The government has increased pressure on the families of some disappeared individuals. The SIM card of a family member of a disappeared person in Tehran has been blocked, and the registration of a car title for one member was prevented by security forces. Additionally, the Instagram pages of the parents of some disappeared individuals have been closed by court order.

Yousef Monzavi announced that he must go to Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad on October 3rd to serve a one-year sentence. He stated that his crime was writing patriotic poems. Monzavi shared this information in a video on social media.

A student from Shiraz was denied entry to class for wearing black jeans instead of the school uniform pants. Due to financial difficulties, he could not afford new uniform pants. The school assistant and principal asked him to change his pants or leave the school.

Restrictions on the activities of Iranian airlines on international routes continue, affected by financial problems and sanctions. A Caspian Airlines plane was seized in Istanbul due to debt. Flights of Iranian airlines to Iraq also face restrictions.

Iraq's Ministry of Transport announced that Iraqi Airlines is preparing to resume flights to Iran after receiving a special exemption. Round-trip flights between Iraq and Iran are expected to restart in October, beginning from Najaf International Airport. These flights will be conducted according to approved regulations.

Iranian airlines have stopped flights to Azerbaijan, Georgia, Oman, UAE, and Iraq. Flights to China, Russia, Turkey, Afghanistan, Pakistan, Armenia, Belarus, and Malaysia continue. This information was reported by domestic Iranian news agencies.

FIFA accused UEFA of launching a misinformation campaign and refused to hand over documents related to the controversial privatization of World Cup shares. UEFA filed a lawsuit in the US demanding disclosure of FIFA's documents, which FIFA denied as baseless. This crisis escalates amid growing opposition to Infantino's presidency.

Families of those killed in the December 2025 protests have reacted to Masoud Pezeshkian's statements about protesters being armed. They say their children only went to the streets to participate in the protests. The families have asked the government to provide evidence for its claims.
The sister of Ehsan Afshari joined the memorial campaign by lighting a candle. Ehsan Afshari, 39, was killed by officers in Tehranpars, Tehran. His sister said, "We neither forgive nor forget."

Mohammadreza Jalaipour described solitary confinement as a pleasurable experience and an opportunity for solitude and meditation. This view is shocking and puzzling for those who have experienced solitary confinement. He expressed this perspective in an interview.
Ali Davoodi won the gold medal in the over 110 kg category. Mahsa Beheshti earned a bronze medal in the 86 kg category. Alireza Nasiri finished fourth in the 110 kg category and did not win a medal.

A Boeing 737 passenger plane of Caspian Airlines was seized in Turkey due to a three million euro debt. The plane was stopped while preparing for a flight from Istanbul to Tehran, and passengers had to disembark. The seizure order was issued by the court.

A student in southern Iran says their school is online but requires tuition payment for enrollment. The family cannot afford the tuition due to war and economic difficulties. The student's father has been laid off and the mother is ill.

Tehran's mayor said that America's plan is to create internal chaos and a direct attack on Iran. He added that the country is moving towards rupture and disorder, which is what America wants. He also warned that America intends to push Iran towards a social explosion.

The spokesperson of the Islamic Republic Army announced a reward of five billion tomans for handing over or capturing any American soldier entering Iranian territory. If the person handing over is a woman, the reward will be doubled to ten billion tomans. This amount was announced by Mohammad Akraminia.

Esther Shachmarov, an Israeli runner, won three gold medals at the 1974 Asian Games in Tehran. This was Israel's last participation in these games. Shachmarov shared memories of Tehran and her sports career in a special interview.

The family of Amir Mahdi Farkhipour, a teenager killed during the Mahsa uprising, joined the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory." They lit a candle at his grave. Amir Mahdi Farkhipour was killed on October 27, 2022, in Tehran.

Mehdi Nazari, a political prisoner, is serving a five-year sentence in Tehran Grand Prison. He was arrested in June and recently assaulted and threatened by a fellow inmate acting as a prison lawyer. Nazari was convicted on charges including assembly and collusion against national security.

Fatemeh Mohajerani, the spokesperson of the Islamic Republic government, called the ban on Iran's flights an example of American bullying. She also thanked the Iraqi people who are pursuing the cancellation of this ban.

Donald Trump said the Iranian government will not acquire nuclear weapons and that the Islamic Republic is failing. He added that this situation will end soon and oil prices will drop. Trump described the US actions against the Islamic Republic as one of the most important historical measures.

A video sent to Iran International shows the presence of IRGC forces and military equipment in a school in Tehran. The video does not specify the exact location or time of the presence. No further information about the event has been released.

The IRGC described the US economy as declining in a letter and stated that the US has failed to achieve its goals. The IRGC urged the American people to stand against their government's policies and suggested they identify as Iranian when traveling abroad. Mehdi Tajik has commented on the reactions to this letter.

JD Vance, the US Vice President, blamed the Islamic Republic for the collapse of the Islamabad agreement, stating they made a mistake by targeting commercial ships. He added that Iranians realized their mistake and could have benefited from improved relations with the US if they had fulfilled their commitments. Vance also mentioned uncertainty about Mojtaba Khamenei's status, saying Washington does not know for sure if he is alive, but evidence suggests he is.
A video shows protesters in Qom writing slogans on a wall. Their slogan concerns the economic situation and people's tables. This video was received by Iran International.

The Danish Foreign Ministry has advised its citizens to avoid traveling to Iran and urged Danes currently in Iran to leave the country. The ministry warned about the risk of detention and limited consular services. Sweden, Norway, and Finland have issued similar warnings.

Broadcast images from IRIB show some classes of Kharazmi University held outdoors next to the ruins of the Bi-Van Bridge in Karaj, damaged during the Iran-US war. The bridge was destroyed in the conflict. The images show classes being held near the damaged bridge.

Benjamin Netanyahu, the Prime Minister of Israel, is scheduled to hold a security assessment meeting on Tuesday evening, 7 Mehr. This decision follows increased security tensions. Netanyahu also warned of a possible enemy attack on Israel ahead of the parliamentary elections.

A severe armed clash is ongoing between Islamic Republic forces and armed individuals in the Gharibabad area of Iranshahr. Dozens of vehicles and a tank have been dispatched to the scene, and drones have also been used. Access routes to the clash site have been blocked by the Islamic Republic forces.

JD Vance, the US Vice President, held officials of the Islamic Republic responsible for the collapse of the Islamabad understanding and said they made a mistake by targeting commercial ships in regional waters. He added that Iranians have realized they made a mistake and could have gained many benefits from improved relations with America if they had fulfilled their commitments.

Donald Trump announced in his speech that the dispute with the Islamic Republic of Iran will soon end. He emphasized that Iran will not obtain nuclear weapons and is collapsing. These remarks caused a sharp drop in global oil prices.

Katrina Bins, Vice President of the Rhineland-Palatinate Parliament in Germany, has taken political sponsorship of Mahbubeh Shabani, a political prisoner sentenced to death. Shabani was sentenced to death on charges of operational actions against Israel and the United States. She has been transferred to solitary confinement in Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad.

Iranian authorities have cut legal government aid to a family whose child was killed in the December 2025 protests. The family members have been removed from the Imam Khomeini Relief Committee's aid list. Additionally, Amir Fernia, son of the missing Majid Fernia, was arrested at his workplace.

Videos show increased military presence in Iranian schools by Basij, IRGC, and police forces. Military training for Hashd al-Shaabi forces in some schools has also been reported. The Islamic Republic is trying to turn schools and universities into places for military recruitment.

Reza Qarabaghi reported the death of an emergency technician in Mazandaran due to ambulance malfunction. He also mentioned the use of worn-out ambulances and the financial difficulties of emergency personnel. Many workers have monthly working hours of up to 240, with salaries ranging from 25 to 30 million tomans.

The dollar in Iran surpassed 255,000 tomans. The deputy health minister urged people not to waste leftover food and to consume it. Simultaneously, a letter from the IRGC to the American people about the country's economic collapse was published.

A video published on social media shows the sighting of an Iranian leopard in Kajur, Mazandaran province. This video has attracted users' attention. The sighting of the Iranian leopard in this area has been recorded.

Mohammad Akraminia, the army spokesperson, stated that the military strategy in the war has shifted from defense to offense. He said that preemptive strikes are carried out before the enemy attacks. He also emphasized that if an imminent enemy attack is detected, preemptive operations will be conducted.

JD Vance described the power structure in Iran as very confusing. He said various groups such as hardliners, conservatives, moderates, and clerics play roles in decision-making. He also added that Mojtaba Khamenei does not interfere much in daily affairs.

The One Million Signatures campaign in Iran was inspired by the women's movement in Morocco in the 1990s. The campaign aims to reform discriminatory family laws and has localized the Moroccan experience in Iran's context. Morocco's family law reforms were finalized in 2004 and are now undergoing new fundamental changes.
In Piranshahr, West Azerbaijan province, a slogan was written on a street wall. The slogan states that students want knowledge and science, not war. A video of this was sent to Iran International.

Mai Sato, the UN special rapporteur, reacted to the death sentences issued for Mohsen Eslamkhah and Shervin Bagherian Jabali. She emphasized that executing individuals who were minors at the time of the alleged acts is completely prohibited. She also called for the halt of these executions.

Jonathan Schaech stated that the Abraham Accords have progressed from normalization to security cooperation between Israel and the UAE. The UAE can act as a bridge between Israel and other Arab countries. Security cooperation between Abu Dhabi and Israel may deepen without the UAE openly joining an anti-Iran coalition.

Ehsan Hajsafi became the record holder for most national football appearances for Iran with 150 games, surpassing Javad Nekounam. He played his first national game in 2008 and has participated in four World Cups. In the match against Russia, Hajsafi entered the field after Mohammad Mehdi Mohebi was injured.

British counter-terrorism police searched several properties in London as part of an investigation into a possible attack on the Fairford airbase. Five men were arrested in connection with the incident and later released on bail. No homemade bombs were found in the vehicle searches, but some gasoline was discovered.
The overturning of a Nissan pickup carrying seasonal workers near Kalateh Khij city in Shahroud resulted in the death and injury of 18 workers, including a 65-year-old woman.

The mother of Parnian Dabiri spoke in a video addressing a government official about the events of January 8 and 9, asking for his understanding. Parnian Dabiri was shot with a military bullet on January 9, 2026. Pashaeian claimed at the UN General Assembly that the January protesters were trained and armed by the US and Israel.

Mohsen Rezaee stated in a meeting with the Deputy Prime Minister of Azerbaijan that Trump is trapped in a quagmire where he can neither negotiate nor fight. He added that Iran's conditions have been communicated to the US, but Trump is unable to make decisions. Rezaee also said the US has no future in the region and Iran stands firmly against it.

Mehroweh Khandan, daughter of Nasrin Sotoudeh, received the Vaclav Havel Human Rights Prize on behalf of her mother in Strasbourg. Nasrin Sotoudeh expressed hope in a video message that freedom will one day come to Iran. She referred to Havel's ideas and his fight against the communist regime in Czechoslovakia.

Mehdi Mahdavi-Azad referred to the letter from the IRGC to the American people in the Cheshmandaz program. He said this letter is a sign that the Supreme Leader is now just a puppet for the IRGC. According to him, everything is now controlled by the IRGC.
Yousef Monzavi, a resident of Mashhad, has been summoned to serve a one-year prison sentence. He must report to Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad. This news was reported by HRANA news agency.

The Iranian national football team lost to Uzbekistan and Russia with scores of 3-1 and 2-0 in the September FIFA window. Amir Ghalenoei had promised the Asian Cup championship after the World Cup elimination. Due to poor results and lack of team renewal, a poll about Ghalenoei's dismissal has been conducted.

Iraq has started importing gasoline through Syria due to disruptions in ship traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. Iraqi trucks loaded gasoline shipments at the Syrian port of Baniyas. This move is part of a three-month agreement between Baghdad and Damascus.

Some workers at the Darnavand company in Karaj protested working conditions, wages, food quality, and treatment, demanding investigation of an alleged assault. Around 300 workers at the Hepco company in Arak gathered to demand September salary payments, contract agreements, and appointment of a qualified manager.

Yashar Tabrizi, a political prisoner in Tabriz prison, has been denied transfer to the hospital despite needing a heart angiography. Prison officials opposed his transfer. This issue has been confirmed by a source close to his family.

The Wall Street Journal reported that the IRGC has lost control of the Strait of Hormuz. It is likely that the IRGC will initiate preemptive attacks against the US to regain this position. This report was released one day after a message attributed to Mojtaba Khamenei.

At the beginning of the academic year, students held protests at Allameh, Kermanshah, and Lorestan universities. These protests were observed at various universities in Iran. An interview with Roghieh Rezaei was conducted about this issue.

The mother of Aida Aghili joined the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory." Aida Aghili was killed by officers' bullets during the National Revolution protests in Tehran. She died at the age of 34.

Iran's Foreign Ministry strongly condemned Benjamin Netanyahu's trip to the UAE. The ministry warned about the dangerous consequences of Israel's presence in the region. It also urged regional countries not to facilitate Israel's presence.

A group of Iranians held a ceremony on Tuesday, 7 Mehr, at the Golders Green memorial wall in London to commemorate Hamid Mahdavi, an Iranian firefighter killed during the December protests. The event coincided with Firefighters' Day. A video of the ceremony was received by Iran International.

Abbas Araghchi said at the end of his trip to New York that Tehran is still waiting for a response from the US regarding the proposal to reopen Hormuz. Meanwhile, Trump stated that Iran is losing and will not obtain nuclear weapons. JD Vance commented on Mojtaba Khamenei, saying the US believes he is alive, although it cannot be stated with certainty.

After the crackdown on the December 2025 protests, a new trend has emerged in Iran where people tattoo political and identity messages on their bodies. These tattoos are increasingly placed on visible parts of the body and represent political memory and dissent. This change has been reported by tattoo artists, protesters, and relatives of the deceased.

Amir Ghalenoei commented after Iran's national football team lost 2-0 to Russia that these matches help identify the team's weaknesses. He stated that some players will not be invited to future camps. He also mentioned the absence of Mohammad Mohebi and Saman Ghoddos due to residency issues and injury.

Donald Trump said the Islamic Republic of Iran is in a very bad situation and may surrender. He also stated that more oil has passed through the Strait of Hormuz in recent days than ever before. Trump emphasized that the goal is to prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons.

At the end of the tenth day of the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya, China leads the medal table with 143 gold medals. Japan and South Korea are second and third with 45 and 24 gold medals respectively. Iran is ranked seventh with 10 gold, 16 silver, and 11 bronze medals.

Elon Musk spoke at the White House about unemployment caused by artificial intelligence, stating that the most likely outcome is an era of abundance with high universal income. He added that the job market will change but demand for human labor will remain high. Musk also highlighted the benefits of AI in improving healthcare.

Farzin Nadimi commented on the suspicious incident near the Fairford airbase, stating that the exact intent of the detained individuals is still unclear. The likelihood of a terrorist operation on the same night is low. It is possible they were training for a larger operation involving explosives.

The US State Department's Rewards for Justice program set a reward of up to $15 million for information about three commanders of the IRGC Aerospace Force, including Ahmad JafarAbadi, Abdullah Mehrabi, and Ali Asghar Norouzi. People were asked to send information via Signal or Tor, and those providing it will be eligible for a reward and relocation.

Morad Vaisi stated that the dollar price in Iran has reached 250,000 tomans. He added that the dollar has increased 35,000 times since the beginning of the revolution. He also referred to Mojtaba Khamenei's remarks about being the first world power.

Morad Vaisi, senior analyst at Iran International, said that a preemptive attack by the Islamic Republic on Israel could be a form of suicide. He added that Netanyahu is waiting for such a mistake. Netanyahu is waiting for an opportunity to resume war with the Islamic Republic.

US Senate investigations reveal that the Islamic Republic extensively uses the cryptocurrency Tether to circumvent sanctions. 84% of 846 wallets linked to the Islamic Republic operated fully with Tether. The report questions why Tether allowed tens of millions of dollars to be transferred despite having the technical ability to block these assets.

Fatima Zahra El Mansouri was introduced as the first female prime minister of Morocco after the Authenticity and Modernity Party won the parliamentary elections. King Mohammed VI of Morocco appointed her to lead the government. The party won 97 seats but needs a coalition to achieve an absolute majority.

Qatari mediators failed to make progress in diplomatic talks between the US and the Islamic Republic. This deadlock has increased the likelihood of renewed military conflict. US officials believe Trump may order military operations after the midterm elections.

Scott Bessent, US Treasury Secretary, stated that the Treasury will continue to target and disrupt those providing material, technological, or financial support for the Iranian government's terrorist activities. He emphasized that no support for the Iranian government will be tolerated.

Shayan Samiei stated that maximum pressure could force Tehran to accept US conditions, but negotiations have become a way to buy time. He described the risk of military escalation as real and serious but not inevitable. The US and Israel may act if the IRGC initiates an attack.

Amir Giti from Iran International stated that American officials are uncertain about Mojtaba Khamenei's status and who is responsible for nuclear decisions in Iran. The US demands clarity on uranium reserves and cessation of Iran's nuclear program. Until these conditions are met, the US and its allies will not lift sanctions.

Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, the Prime Minister of Qatar, stated that the White House informed him about the imminent military operation half an hour before the war with the Islamic Republic began. He said on the program "Piers Morgan Uncensored" that he was asleep in Doha when the White House called. American officials informed him that the military operation would start soon.

British police foiled a suspicious plot to attack the RAF Fairford base and arrested five suspects. Counter-terrorism investigations are examining possible links between the suspects and the Islamic Republic. The Islamic Republic has denied any involvement in the incident.

On Tuesday, 7th of Mehr, the Wall Street Journal wrote that the Islamic Republic's reduced ability to block the Strait of Hormuz and use it as leverage may increase the risk of military escalation by Tehran. According to Kepler data, the volume of oil passing through Hormuz and alternative routes has reached about 80% of pre-war levels, but the Islamic Republic has been unable to pass its crude oil through the Strait since the US naval blockade in July, and Iran's oil reserves outside the blockade zone may run out by mid-October. The newspaper also wrote that declining oil revenues and the weakening of Tehran's leverage in the Strait of Hormuz may push the Islamic Republic to resume attacks to increase pressure.

The Wall Street Journal reported that the Islamic Republic's reduced ability to block oil flow through the Strait of Hormuz may increase the risk of military escalation by Tehran. According to the report, the US Navy and Gulf oil producers have been more successful in countering attacks or using alternative routes, and data shows the volume of oil passing through Hormuz and alternative routes has reached about 80% of pre-war levels. In contrast, the Islamic Republic has been unable to export its crude oil through Hormuz since the reimposition of the US naval blockade in July, and Iran's oil reserves outside the blockade may run out by mid-October.

Naib Karami, a 25-year-old from Bani Nar village in Salas Babajani, Kermanshah, was shot dead by military forces while herding near the border area. Local sources report that the village is surrounded by military and security forces. This incident occurred in the border strip of Kermanshah province.

Syrian authorities announced the dismantling of a three-member cell linked to Hezbollah in Daraa province. The suspects were accused of attempting to install a rocket launch platform and carry out attacks against security. The arrests were coordinated with internal security forces.

The US State Department sanctioned Iranian airline Saha and Russian companies Yakovlev and MG-Flot for involvement in supplying military equipment and transferring weapons related to Iran. Additionally, 10 individuals and entities were sanctioned for providing arms to Iran's Ministry of Defense. The US has also requested information about three officials linked to the IRGC Aerospace Force.

Norman Roule, a former CIA official, stated that if the Islamic Republic remains, its behavior will likely follow the pattern of recent decades. He added that the IRGC is now in power and has established Tehran's proxy forces network. Additionally, the Quds Force plays a key role in Iran's regional foreign policy.

The death sentences of Ali Hemmati and Majid Nikandish, two detainees of the Iranian National Revolution in Mashhad, were carried out early Wednesday, October 8. They were arrested in January 2026 in the Tabarsi area of Mashhad. The death sentences were executed after confirmation by the Supreme Court and following legal procedures.

The Judiciary of the Islamic Republic announced the execution of two individuals arrested during last December's protests in Mashhad. They were accused of involvement in the killing of four security forces. The execution was carried out after the Supreme Court confirmed the sentence.

Mona Mahmoudian, wife of Ebrahim Mostafipour, and Amir Fernia, son of the missing Majid Fernia, were arrested at their workplaces. The detaining authority and their place of detention are currently unknown. Both individuals are from families of those killed in the December 8 protests in Mazandaran.

Israeli media reported a possible hijacking of a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv, prompting Israeli fighter jets to scramble. The plane sent an emergency code and was redirected toward Saudi Arabia, carrying over 150 Israelis. The reason for the emergency code and route change remains unknown, and Flydubai has not issued an official statement.

Reuters, citing three Israeli security officials, reported that Benjamin Netanyahu is consulting about a Flydubai flight from the UAE to Israel that has deviated from its route. The plane is expected to land soon in Saudi Arabia. The reason for the change in the plane's route has not yet been disclosed.

The judiciary executed the death sentences of Ali Hemmati Sistanian and Majid Nikandish after approval by the Supreme Court. These two were detainees from the December 2025 protests in Mashhad. The execution took place early this morning.

In Kish Island, living conditions are very limited after the war and costs have increased. In Shiraz, the electricity consumption pattern has changed and electricity bills have risen sharply. Additionally, daily power outages have been reported in Isfahan and Shazand.

Reuters, citing an informed source, reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met with Qatari mediators in Doha on Tuesday evening and received the US response to the proposed 'seven-day confidence-building' plan. He will convey the response to Tehran on Wednesday. The document under negotiation is a plan to build trust and return to an enhanced version of the 'Islamabad Understanding' signed in June, and the main disagreement is over the sequence of actions.

Zahra Azadpour, a football player for Mehregan Pardis Club, was killed on the evening of January 9, 2026, in Karaj by the Islamic Republic's suppression forces. She was born in 1998 and had played for Azarakhsh Shahriar and Saba teams. Azadpour had also been invited to the Iranian women's national football team camp.

The spokesperson for the Israeli Prime Minister stated that the Flydubai flight incident was not a hijacking. Israeli media reported that the warning was mistaken and caused by a violent altercation among passengers. The Flydubai flight is currently landing in Saudi Arabia.

Today marks the fourth anniversary of the Bloody Friday in Zahedan during the 2022 protests. On that day, military and security forces fired on protesters, resulting in about one hundred deaths including 15 children. The report reviews the events, involved individuals, and the judicial process of the case.

A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv landed at Tabuk Airport in Saudi Arabia after changing its route. Israeli media reported that after this landing, the airspace of Ben Gurion Airport was reopened.
Importers of essential goods gathered in front of the Ministry of Agriculture on October 7. They demanded the settlement of their claims. This was shown in a video received by Iran International.

The US and its coalition partners have officially ended the military mission "Operation Inherent Resolve" against ISIS in Iraq. The responsibility for combating ISIS remnants has been handed over to the Iraqi government. The US will continue to provide training and intelligence support to its Iraqi partners.

Hamidreza Hemmati's father congratulated Firefighters' Day and paid tribute to Hamid Mahdavi, a firefighter killed during the December protests. Hamidreza Hemmati was killed by suppressors in Isfahan on January 8, 2026. He was 21 years old.
Rashid Hesami, a teacher from Qorveh, was released from Sanandaj prison on bail.

The Iranian national football team lost two consecutive matches against Uzbekistan and Russia, conceding five goals. Media outlets have warned about the team's identity crisis and future direction. It remains unclear what football style the national team will pursue.

The US has imposed new sanctions on the weapons supply network of Iran's Ministry of Defense. Those sanctioned include the Ministry's representative in Beijing, Kavoshcom Asia company, and the Hong Kong company EC Mojo. These sanctions target several countries.

Family and close ones of Mohammad Sepiani commemorated his birthday beside his tomb. Mohammad Sepiani was killed by agents on January 9, 2026, in Najafabad, Isfahan. He was 27 years old at the time of his death.

Mostafa Dehpahlevan blamed the Ministry of Cultural Heritage for neglecting the protection of historical artifacts. He stated that over 70% of those involved in the smuggling mafia do not have financial problems. He also reported instances of a parliament member and an imam participating in illegal excavations.

Heydar Chahchamandi, a political prisoner, was released from Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad on Tuesday, 7 Mehr. He is under electronic monitoring and will serve the remainder of his sentence outside prison. Chahchamandi had previously been sentenced to four years in prison.

A Flydubai plane flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after activating an emergency code. The plane communicated with air traffic control. More details were provided by an Iran International reporter.
